proposed_core_edits.reason: Adds the classical multihomogeneous Bezout result used by the isolated-root count to the declared proof spine.

proposed.justification: This gives the first universal parameterized ceiling for one algebraic edge coordinate beyond directed trees.
proposed.gap: Existing tree-only identification theory and old higher-degree small SEM examples do not bound a single coordinate by excess-parent count.
proposed.consumer: A fixed-parameter symbolic engine can allocate elimination degree and certificate storage before seeing numerical covariance values.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Declares the published generic rational-univariate specialization theorem and Schwartz--Zippel bound used in the certificate proof.

proposed.justification: The exceptional set makes the word generic auditable and excludes poles, lost leading terms, and infinity components explicitly.
proposed.gap: Generic rational-univariate specialization theory supplies general bad loci, but no existing result packages covariance localization of the prime SEM incidence ideal and single-edge projection into a causal graph certificate.
proposed.consumer: Users can test whether an observed or simulated covariance lies inside the certified operating region before interpreting polynomial roots.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Declares the semialgebraic stratification theorem used to construct the smooth connected regular cell.

proposed.justification: The regular statistical domain must be shown nonvacuous and its real identified set must be nonempty rather than imposed by assumption.
proposed.gap: Standard stratification arguments isolate smooth cells, but the stated lemma ties such a cell to the certified SEM exceptional locus and to rootwise real extension.
proposed.consumer: The inference theorem obtains a genuine compact operating region and a nonempty target set on every data-generating covariance in that region.

open_obligations.what_is_open: The exact value of \(D_k(n)\) for every positive \(k\) with \(n<2k+4\), together with attaining graph families and a separating original edge.
open_obligations.obstruction: The orientation coefficient is a valid upper bound, but the frozen core has no theorem showing that an extremizing block orientation system is realizable by covariance residuals without forced coefficient relations, affine losses, or roots at infinity.
open_obligations.attempted: I proved the universal orientation ceiling, the all-\(k\) one-sink attainment region, the tree boundary, and an exact five-vertex quartic. These do not determine the remaining strip.

open_obligations.what_is_open: The exhaustive characteristic-zero census of every rooted graph-query orbit with \(n\le5\) and \(k\le2\).
open_obligations.obstruction: The supplied computation enumerated orientation graphs but did not enumerate mixed-graph bidirected supports and original-edge queries modulo rooted isomorphism, nor produce saturated rational-univariate certificates for all of them.
open_obligations.attempted: I lifted the supplied modular quartic to an exact rational Groebner basis and matched its four simple branches to the multihomogeneous coefficient.

open_obligations.what_is_open: A complete fixed-parameter implementation proof for both algorithm tags, including the covariance-only circuit descent, every divisor stratum, and the dominance certificate.
open_obligations.obstruction: Generic rational-univariate theory covers a zero-dimensional sliced system, but it does not by itself prove that the source-prime component and every pole or zero-over-zero stratum can be selected and certified within the claimed \(n^{C(k+1)}\) circuit bound.
open_obligations.attempted: I reduced the task to at most \(2k\) quadratic variables, bounded the zero-dimensional degree, and derived the multiplication-matrix route to the coordinate minimal polynomial. The missing component-selection and certificate-size analysis is the remaining crux.

open_obligations.what_is_open: The advertised finite if-and-only-if real-extension certificate for every regular specialization, especially on positive-dimensional fibers and recorded pole divisors.
open_obligations.obstruction: The arithmetic model has no finite encoding for an arbitrary real covariance, and the available bivariate rational-univariate source does not cover real feasibility of every positive-dimensional incidence stratum.
open_obligations.attempted: I proved the exact residual criterion and the positive-definiteness conclusion by congruence, but neither supplies the missing finite real sample-point certificate.
